title: Merge Pop
tagline: Swipe, merge, pop. Reach 128 before the moves run out.
hook: The caption asks a question, Can you merge to 128, and the board already holds a 64 and a 32, so the goal feels close from the first frame. A finger swipes across the screen, and the first swipe merges something, with a pop, a note and a score.
coreLoop: Swipe to slide every tile. Two equal tiles that meet merge into one of double value, and each move spawns a new 2 or 4. The player has 24 moves to make a 128. The spawns come from a seed, so the same moves always give the same game.

levers.name: A question as the hook
levers.why: A text hook that asks something starts the player's thinking before the first input.
levers.how: The caption Can you merge to 128 shows over the board and slides away after the first swipe.

levers.name: Goal in sight
levers.why: A goal that looks reachable keeps people playing. A goal that looks far makes them leave.
levers.how: The board opens with a 64 and a 32 and the first move already merges. A progress bar fills on a log scale toward 128.

levers.name: Pressure with a clear limit
levers.why: A move limit turns a relaxed puzzle into a challenge and gives the run a fixed length.
levers.how: The move counter turns red and throbs under six moves. The run ends at 24 moves, so the ad stays within the 30 to 50 second window.

levers.name: Combos and big merges
levers.why: Variable rewards make some moves feel special, and special moves are the ones people remember.
levers.how: Two or more merges in one swipe show COMBO with a zoom punch and a second note. A merge of 64 or more shows HUGE with a shake and a bigger burst.

levers.name: Near-win tension
levers.why: Being one step from winning is the strongest reason to try once more.
levers.how: With two 64 tiles on the board the game shows ONE MERGE TO WIN. Losing with a 64 on the board earns two stars.

levers.name: Fair difficulty, tested
levers.why: A puzzle that is too hard feels broken, and one that is too easy is boring.
levers.how: A test plays 200 seeds with a simple bot and fails if it wins under 30 percent or over 80 percent of them. A human who plans ahead wins more than the bot.

levers.name: Second chance with a gift
levers.why: A loss that offers something to come back for keeps the player.
levers.how: The first failure offers TRY AGAIN with 6 extra moves. The second failure leaves only the install button.

events.name: impression
events.meaning: The ad is ready and visible, and the game starts.

events.name: first_move
events.meaning: Milliseconds from start to the first swipe. The key hook metric.

events.name: move
events.meaning: A swipe changed the board. Carries direction, merges, best tile and moves left.

events.name: blocked
events.meaning: A swipe that moved nothing. A high rate can mean the controls are unclear.

events.name: combo
events.meaning: Two or more merges in one swipe.

events.name: near_win
events.meaning: The board holds a 64 and the goal is one merge away.

events.name: idle_nudge
events.meaning: Nobody swiped for 2.5 seconds and the finger sped up.

events.name: fail
events.meaning: The run was lost. Carries the reason, no moves left or no legal move.

events.name: retry
events.meaning: The player used the second chance and took the extra moves.

events.name: win
events.meaning: A 128 was made. Carries moves left and the score.

events.name: end_card
events.meaning: The end card is shown. Carries outcome, stars, best tile and score.

events.name: cta_click
events.meaning: The install button was pressed. Carries where it was pressed.

instant-motion.note: The board is still until the first swipe. Only the caption and the swipe finger move, so the first frame is calmer than in the other two.

text-hook.note: The caption Can you merge to 128 opens as a question and slides away after the first swipe.

one-control.note: One swipe in any direction, with arrow keys on desktop. A sliding finger shows it.

first-reward.note: The opening layout guarantees a merge on the first moves, with a pop, a note and a score.

pattern-interrupt.note: Combos and HUGE merges break the rhythm, but they depend on the player. There is no scheduled change.

variable-reward.note: Combos, merges of different size with rising notes, and random spawns from a seed.

open-loop.note: A progress bar on a log scale toward 128 and a move counter that runs down.

near-miss.note: ONE MERGE TO WIN appears with two 64 tiles, and losing with a 64 earns two stars.

instant-retry.note: The first failure offers TRY AGAIN with 6 extra moves.

sound-haptics.note: Merge notes that climb a scale with the tile value, a blocked-move buzz and vibrations. Audio starts after the first swipe.

cliffhanger-end.note: Stars and the best tile, then a teaser about a 256 goal in Level 2 and a PLAY LEVEL 2 button. Level 2 is a teaser: the button goes to the store link.

measured.note: Events include first_move, blocked, combo and near_win, all listed on this page.
